blocks.text:
After breakfast, you will visit the Brazilian side of Iguaçu Falls. You can hear the roar of the water before reaching the main viewing platforms. The Guarani people called this place “Big Water”. The complex comprises 275 cascades, and the falls can be viewed from both Brazil and Argentina.

One of the best-known sections is Devil's Throat. Trails and viewing platforms lead close enough to the falls for you to feel the spray and see the cascades from different viewpoints.

**Iguaçu Falls tour in Brazil — Macuco Safari**

If you wish, you can order a disc containing a recording of the trip.

Return to the hotel after the tour.
